name: Rolan Shubelts
source:
He lived with his father, who passed away 2 years ago.

He now manages an inn on his own.

In a world where discrimination is strong against demi-humans,
he holds an extremely strong prejudice towards female demi-humans.

"... I hate demi-humans"
